status: Designed to the JLCPCB JLC041622-7628 build (4 layers, 1.6 mm, 2 oz outer and inner), per the owner's choice of JLCPCB on 2026-09-26. Thicknesses from JLCPCB's stackup API as captured by github.com/gsuberland/jlcpcb_autogenerated_stackups (normalised_json, 2025-05). The laminate is Nan Ya NP-155F (Tg 150, CTI PLC 3, 175-249 V, group IIIa); JLCPCB may substitute KB or Shengyi, so the CTI must be confirmed on the order. Each prepreg is 7628 + 2116 + 2116; the 0.5 mm core separates In1 (HV_RET) and In2 (BUS_P). Declared thickness is the stackup sum (1.653 mm including 10 um masks); it is ordered as JLCPCB's nominal 1.6 mm board (+/-10%).
